vetSays.line: 🛡️ Eric, the person in their 20s, Asel and the woman in her 40s, with a farmer's tan met them at the door — 4 put down. Eric, Asel, the woman in her 40s, with a farmer's tan are hurt.
🛡️ Piper, Eric, Kamal, Mara and Carlos met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Piper, Eric, Kamal, Mara are hurt.
🛡️ Piper, Eric, Kamal and Maya met them at the door — 4 put down. Piper, Eric, Kamal, Maya are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
Scarred Sunback is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
You STRIKE the Scarred Sunback for 83 (Hunting spear).
Scarred Sunback's attack hits you for 3.
You STRIKE the Scarred Sunback for 104 (Hunting spear).
The Scarred Sunback falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Sunback!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Piper just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kamal just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Piper, Eric, Kamal, Mara and Maya met them at the door — 5 put down. Piper, Eric, Kamal, Mara, Maya are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Valeria taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Valeria drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
